name: FeedRationPlanner
tagline: Rations, mixing sheets and feed stock cover for every livestock group – in one Power Platform app.
description: Complete feed ration module for dairy, beef and mixed livestock units: ration versions by feed group with ingredients, dry matter, kg per head, cost per head per day, DM-intake targets, a four-eyes approval workflow, TMR mixing sheets with mixer-capacity checks, feed stock days remaining with reorder lists and side-by-side version comparison with yearly cost impact.
features: DM intake, ME, CP, NDF and forage share per ration
Cost per head / day, per group and per kg DM incl. shrink
Draft → Proposed → Approved → Active → Archived workflow with four-eyes approval and override reasons
Automatic archive of the previous active version
Inline kg editing in draft rations
New version copy and version comparison with yearly cost impact
Mixing sheet with loading order, scale readings and mixer-capacity warning
Stock cover in days, low/critical thresholds, deliveries, stock counts and reorder list
Bulk price and stock updates with locked-line skipping
Demo mode, undo, CSV export, keyboard and phone layouts
controlType: standard (two controls: FeedRationPlanner data-set + FeedRationPlannerPortal field control, shared src/app)
